name: macsync
title: MacSync
description: Sync your Dock, apps and settings across your Macs with MacSync
author: mehdi_saharkhiz

commands.name: open-window
commands.title: Open Sync Window
commands.description: Open MacSync's window to review and apply changes from your other Macs

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync Now
commands.description: Save this Mac's setup and check your other Macs. Changes nothing here.

commands.name: pull
commands.title: Apply Dock Layout
commands.description: Preview the latest Dock layout, then apply it to this Mac

commands.name: undo
commands.title: Undo Last Apply
commands.description: Put the Dock back as it was before the last apply

commands.name: status
commands.title: Show Status
commands.description: Show each Mac and whether it's in sync

commands.name: history
commands.title: Show History
commands.description: Open MacSync's history to go back to before any saved apply

commands.name: homebrew-updates
commands.title: Check Homebrew Updates
commands.description: See which Homebrew apps and tools, npm packages and uv tools have newer versions

commands.name: homebrew-upgrade
commands.title: Update Homebrew Apps
commands.description: Update every Homebrew app and tool, npm package and uv tool. Apps you have open wait.

commands.name: share
commands.title: Share My Setup
commands.description: Make a file a friend opens in MacSync to get your apps, tools, settings and config

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
